title: Build a class on another with extends
objective: Make a class that extends another, so it gets the parent's fields and methods, and replace a method when the child needs different behavior.

body.text: A class can extend another class. Write class, the new name, extends, then the parent's name. The child class gets the parent's fields and methods without writing them again. If the child writes a can line with the same name as a parent's method, its version replaces the parent's for that child.

body.title: Replace a method in the child
body.code:
class animal
    can speak
        say "..."

class dog extends animal
    can speak
        say "Woof"

make d equal to a new dog
speak d

body.text: A child that does not write a method uses the parent's. Fields and the construction clause come from the parent too, so a new child is built the same way as a new parent.

body.title: Inherit a field and a method
body.code:
class animal
    has name of type text
    construction
        takes text called who
        set name of myself to who
    can introduce
        say name of myself

class dog extends animal
    can bark
        say "Woof"

make d equal to a new dog with who "Ada"
introduce d
bark d

body.prompt: The cat has its own speak, but nothing ever speaks, so the program prints nothing. Make it print Meow.
body.starter:
class animal
    can speak
        say "..."

class cat extends animal
    can speak
        say "Meow"

make c equal to a new cat
